title: First day in a recording studio at Victor
summary: He arrived early to the Victor studio, watched Fats test the piano and the mikes go up, and heard himself for the first time on playback.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Oh sure. I saw him come, I saw the guys come up. We went inside. I didn't know what to do, and they pulled off their jackets and coats and thing, and

take out their horns, and sat there and I saw other men come in, and engineers and stuff, and set up this, and putting up the mikes. He was sitting at the piano, trying to find out which was the best A. You know. I didn't know what was happening.
Your first time in a recording studio.

First time in a recording studio. And we got started, and started playing. Oh man, he would play something, he would play this. He said all right, Herman, you come in and you do this, you play down the first sixteen, the second sixteen, second eight, and do -- you do this, you come in, this and that, we'll try that. We tried it, and ah, pretty good. It was okay, we'll try it again, and the engineer said that's pretty good. Give us another one, you know.
He kept saying that, otherwise, 'all right, nice, record.' Fats Said (Unintelligible) 'well, play it back.' And we played it back and I heard Herman I says 'Is that me?'
Is that me? Oh man, I don't know what -- I don't know, you know. Hearing myself for the first time.
